about_the_game:
Fixing The Apocalypse asks what kind of leader you are, and reveals what kind of ending you’ll reach in this mysterious world based on your ideology. Every choice is designed to return to you in time, offering a personalized experience with over thirty different endings. As you peel back the layers of a cryptic narrative, you’ll be responsible for meeting your people's needs, engaging in battles when necessary with strategic planning, and trying to prevent your character from going insane during the mini-games played to fall asleep. 

Fixing The Apocalypse is a first-person political management simulation where absurdity and gravity coexist. Sometimes you’ll face difficult moral dilemmas; other times, you’ll stand against other communities and ideologies for the good of your city. Some decisions will drag you into wars that require turn-based strategic thinking, allowing you to craft your own military tactics. Throughout this journey, your ideology and every decision tied to it will shape your unique story and ending. The world’s politics are presented through communities with distinct ideologies and beliefs—sometimes in humorous, sometimes in terrifying symbolic ways.

You are the son of a man who once sought to save the world from the apocalypse—and now you're at the helm of the experiment. People have voluntarily entered the facility, yet many behave strangely. Some are devout, some are mad, some are lustful, and many more... Will you be able to meet the needs of these communities and uncover the secrets behind the experiment?

short_description: Fixing the Apocalypse is an RPG and Micro-Management game where your decisions shape the story and the ending. It also features turn-based strategic battles, allowing you to lead your forces. There are no right decisions here only yours. ARE YOU READY TO BE THE PRESIDENT?
